children: Synchrony Financial reported monthly charge-off and delinquency statistics through August 31, 2026, showing a net charge-off rate of 4.9% for August.
Company furnished monthly charge-off and delinquency statistics for the 13 months ended Aug 31, 2026; will continue monthly disclosures.
Period-end loan receivables were $103.0B as of Aug 31, 2026, up from $102.6B in July.
30+ delinquency rate remained steady at 4.2% in Aug, unchanged from July and June.
Net charge-off rate declined to 4.9% in Aug from 4.7% in July and 5.3% in June; adjusted net charge-off also 4.9% in Aug.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
